enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Resume sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread on counter. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Close cabinet. Pick up bread. Place bread on plate. Open microwave. Put plate in microwave. Close microwave. Press start button. Wait. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Open drawer. Take out knife. Close drawer. Open microwave. Take out plate. Close microwave. Pick up knife. Spread butter on bread. Put down knife. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat bread. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Place clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Close drawer. Sit on bed. Put on socks. Stand up. Walk to mirror. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Put down comb. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. See bus approaching. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Put down bag. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Open patient files. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record temperature. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Return to patient room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Make phone call. Walk to break room. Sit down. Eat lunch. Walk back to desk. Attend meeting. Review charts. Walk to patient room. Assist patient. Walk to desk. Complete paperwork. Turn off computer. Pick up bag. Walk out of building.

Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Open door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Put down knife. Pick up meat. Place meat on cutting board. Pick up knife. Cut meat. Put down knife. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir with spatula. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on living room light. Walk to couch. Sit down. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Watch video. Close laptop. Put down laptop. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Walk out of bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn off bedroom light. Walk to bed. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
